summary: Vox Royalty Corp. filed a Form 6-K announcing a press release update on its gold offtake-stream exposure to Equinox Gold's Los Filos mine following Equinox's signing of 20-year land access agreements. Vox holds a 50% gold offtake-stream up to 1,100,000 ounces, with approximately 588,000 ounces remaining. No transaction, acquisition, divestiture, or corporate event is being filed; this is a routine operational update on an existing royalty stream. The filing is a foreign private issuer report, analogous to a Form 8-K, but purely informational.
